task.goal: List the people (names and contact details) included in the targeted audience

task_results.sql:
WITH rpt_audience_people AS (
SELECT src.campaign_id, src.contact_id, src.created_at, src.campaign_name, src.cdp_id, src.first_name, src.last_name, src.email FROM (
SELECT a.campaign_id, a.contact_id, a.created_at, c.name AS campaign_name,
       p.cdp_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, ik.key_value AS email
FROM campaign.campaign_audience a
JOIN campaign.campaigns c ON c.id = a.campaign_id AND c.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
JOIN cdp.customer_profile p
  ON p.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
 AND regexp_replace(p.cdp_id, '^.*-', '') = a.contact_id::text
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT k.key_value
  FROM cdp.identity_keys k
  WHERE k.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
    AND k.cdp_id = p.cdp_id
    AND lower(k.key_type) IN ('email', 'primary_email')
  ORDER BY k.verified DESC NULLS LAST, k.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) ik ON TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT c.id AS campaign_id, NULL::bigint AS contact_id, c.created_at, c.name AS campaign_name,
       p.cdp_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, ik.key_value AS email
FROM campaign.campaigns c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(c.launch_plan->'audience_cdp_ids', '[]'::jsonb)) AS x(cdp_id)
JOIN cdp.customer_profile p ON p.organization_id = %(_org_id)s AND p.cdp_id = x.cdp_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT k.key_value
  FROM cdp.identity_keys k
  WHERE k.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
    AND k.cdp_id = p.cdp_id
    AND lower(k.key_type) IN ('email', 'primary_email')
  ORDER BY k.verified DESC NULLS LAST, k.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) ik ON TRUE
WHERE c.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
  AND regexp_replace(x.cdp_id, '^.*-', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$'
) src WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT id FROM campaign.campaigns WHERE organization_id = %(_org_id)s AND branch_id = %(_branch_id)s)
)
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM rpt_audience_people AS audience_people LIMIT 100000
